description: Invented document snippets and manually assigned question labels for the offline ranking demo. These are not operational instructions or descriptions of a real service.

documents.text: In this invented workshop application, enrollment of a second authentication factor is recorded on the MFA settings screen. The enrollment guide covers registering that factor.
The invented workshop application's session guide describes the fictional session-expiry indicator and the sign-out button. It does not describe second-factor enrollment.
The synthetic backup checklist describes creating a daily backup artifact and recording its fictional artifact identifier. Restoration is described in a separate guide.
The synthetic restoration guide describes selecting a backup artifact and checking the restored test records. It refers to the daily-backup checklist for artifact creation.
The fictional invoice guide describes a sample invoice status field and a preview operation. All amounts and records in this imagined interface are synthetic.
The fictional refund guide describes marking a synthetic transaction for review. It contains no warehouse, transport or equipment specifications.

The imagined deployment exercise starts by directing a test cohort to a candidate revision. This snippet describes that canary step; a separate rollback guide describes returning to the prior revision.
The imagined rollback exercise returns the test cohort to the prior revision and checks the revision marker. It complements the separate canary exercise.
The synthetic incident worksheet assigns the label SEV1 to its highest exercise severity. This document explains that label and its fictional triage checklist.
The synthetic retrospective template contains sections for an exercise timeline and follow-up notes. Severity-label definitions belong to the incident worksheet, not this template.
